scope: Original linked-local-image renderer blocker and synthetic DOCX/PDF usability on the recorded macOS/runtime. No semantic qualification or comparative-performance claim.

review.kind: same-team source/evidence review by the regression-test author; separate from inspector authorship, not blind or independent study qualification

limits: Acceptance is limited to this separate inspector and recorded macOS runtime with synthetic cases. No blanket host security, arbitrary-document or cross-platform guarantee.
Before/after hashes are not atomic pins against a hostile host; standard OS roots are not an immutable full OS snapshot.
Filesystem metadata/existence queries, native process execution/fork and declared system-service prerequisites remain allowed under the policy.
Process-group timeout and direct process settlement do not establish descendant quiescence; hard memory/disk limits and suspend-inclusive clock guarantees are absent.
Non-embedded font substitution can change appearance; valid PNGs and a green parser do not establish glyph/content fidelity. Full-page review remains required.
Parser size limits can be checked after allocations, particularly PDF decoding; no general hostile-parser containment claim.
Raw receipts include host/runtime paths; blinded release requires the separate custody/projection layer.
No real reviewer calibration, semantic method qualification, fresh study access, phase admission, new provider execution or Atlas-Hermes parity is established.
